description: Defines structures, macros, and inline functions for the Xtensa GDB stub integration in Zephyr OS, including register descriptions and context management.

methods.name: gdb_xtensa_is_logical_addr_reg
methods.description: Checks if a register is a logical address register (A0 - A15).

methods.name: gdb_xtensa_is_address_reg
methods.description: Checks if a register is an address register (AR0 - AR31/AR63).

methods.name: gdb_xtensa_is_special_reg
methods.description: Checks if a register is a special register accessed via RSR/WSR.

methods.name: gdb_xtensa_is_user_reg
methods.description: Checks if a register is a user register accessed via RUR/WUR.
